label: The customers' queued work
description: What the customers ask of the broker their queued work goes through, jobs.connection.json, apart from publishing to it: that it be made ready before anything publishes to it or consumes it. A startup step fires it, under the profiles whose broker is a table.

prepare.description: Make the broker behind jobs.connection.json ready to keep queues, once, before the port opens: create what it needs, and leave alone what is there.
